title: Backup destination admission and source page-size adoption

scope.rationale: checkReadTransaction and setDestPgsz are the destination admission pair used by backup initialization/first step: reject any destination transaction before backup ownership begins, then attempt to adopt the source page size without changing reserve bytes.
excluded_responsibilities: WAL/memory page-size mismatch rejection after destination lock

external_source_responsibilities: B-tree page-size setter and reserve-byte owner
Caller records public destination error text
dependencies.caller_closure: Both complete source helper bodies are assigned. initialize consumes destination admission and first step consumes source page-size adoption before opening copy work.

inputs: Borrowed destination Btree; borrowed source Btree for page-size adoption
outputs: Success only for transaction-none destination; destination page size equal to nonzero source page size with reserve bytes unchanged
contracts.ownership: Borrowed typed trees; page-size helper mutates only destination.page_size.
contracts.state_and_results: Any read or write destination transaction yields DestinationBusy. A valid source page size replaces destination page size. Zero source page size maps to typed Io rather than publishing an invalid geometry.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No direct I/O or callbacks. Connection/Btree locking is external.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Admission failure does not mutate destination. Invalid source geometry does not mutate destination. Successful adoption leaves the destination ready for backup transaction setup.

representation_differences: The source database error-message side effect is owned by the public connection layer; this typed helper returns DestinationBusy.
sqlite3BtreeSetPageSize reserve argument zero means preserve reserve bytes, represented by mutating page_size only.
The bounded Btree has no page-size setter I/O failure, so zero source size is the only local typed failure.

oracle.protocol: Reject a destination in read transaction, accept a transaction-none destination, adopt source 512-byte pages into a 1024-byte destination while retaining reserve_bytes=7, then run complete backup initialization/step.
internal_observations: destination page size before and after adoption
oracle.normalization: Compare exact typed errors, page sizes, reserve byte, and copy completion.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No direct I/O; synchronization and later write transaction external.
assurance.malformed_input: Zero source page size returns Io; typed trees preclude null.
assurance.continuation: Failures preserve destination fields; success feeds first-step setup.

integration.native_call_path: initialize calls checkReadTransaction; first step calls setDestinationPageSize for ordinary rollback destinations before setting destination transaction write.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Inline destination transaction and direct page-size mutation are retired.

independent_review.notes: Requires public Backup owner integration, pinned-C admission/page-size trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Connect the internal source-shaped backup state machine to the public Backup owner.
Add pinned-C admission and page-size trace.
